library_preparation_preflight.summary: JCTools Core is a standalone in-process queue library; version 4.0.3 has no runtime Maven dependencies, external services, or required configuration.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Exercise org.jctools.queues.MpscLinkedQueue directly with offer/poll operations so BaseLinkedQueue and LinkedQueueNode initialization reaches the reported reflective field lookups. No environment variables or system properties are required.
risks: Reusing only the existing SpscUnboundedArrayQueue coverage may not reach producerNode, consumerNode, and next.
The default queue implementations use sun.misc.Unsafe through the JDK's jdk.unsupported module; Native Image verification remains authoritative.
